name: Shogun Restaurant
notes: Restaurant's own site, 8-location chain (Pasadena, La Verne, Rancho Cucamonga, Corona, Temecula, San Marcos, San Diego, Palm Desert). This San Diego location's page (/locations/san-diego/, address 5451 Kearny Villa Rd, confirmed) links the same shared menu pages the whole chain uses (/menu/teppan/, /sushi/, /dining/, /drinks/, /happy-hour/, /kids/ -- /menu/seasonal/ carried no priced items); the site itself states 'These menus are shared by our 8 Shogun-branded locations. Some items and prices may vary by location.' Extracted from the schema.org Menu JSON-LD embedded on each page (hasMenuSection/hasMenuItem/offers/price), which is more complete than the visible HTML for this site (e.g. Happy Hour's page only prints one headline price per group visually but the JSON-LD carries every item's own offer). Sushi and steak size-variants (Sushi 2pcs vs Sashimi 4pcs; Regular vs Sumo Cut) are recorded as separate rows via a '(variant)' suffix on the name. Prices cluster on .00/.50 (2 items end .80) with no markup pattern and are plausible for a 2026 premium teppanyaki/sushi restaurant (entrees $17-65, premium bottles up to $250). Held to medium rather than high because of the shared-menu/price-may-vary disclaimer -- this is the chain's own published pricing for this location's page, not a location-specific PDF or POS export.
